IC1: Patient over 18 years weighing between 65 and 85 Kg
IC2: Referred for STEMI within 6 hours from beginning of chest pain [OR] or stable coronary artery disease requiring a loading dose of Prasugrel [OR] or Ticagrelor according to the international recommendations.
IC3: [NOT] No previous treatment with Clopidogrel [OR], Prasugrel [OR] or Ticagrelor.
IC4: Patient fasting for at least 6 hours.
IC5: Affiliate or receiving a social security system.
